title: FSR for DungeonDodge
description: Add textures for some mining items and gear for the DungeonDodge server.
body:
**PRE 1.21.5 DO NOT UPDATE Fabric Language Kotlin beyond 1.13.4+kotlin.2.2.0 OR IT WILL CRASH**

I added some textures for mining tools like pickaxes and drills. Many of the drill textures were already included in the server’s texture pack files.

I also used Firmament to make some FurfSky textures (specifically GUI and Gemstones) compatible.

Since this is my first texture pack ever, there might be some bugs or things that don’t work perfectly, sorry about that!

**Important / How to fix missing textures:** 
You must lower the priority of the Server Resource Pack. Since the required mod is installed automatically, simply go to your resource pack list and move the Server Pack below this resource pack and FurfSky to ensure everything loads correctly.

Post bug-reports or suggestions on [Discord](https://discord.gg/PVTTTeDm).
